title: fix(security)!: an app-authored hook's inherited elevation, its sudo() and an action it reaches by execute() write no identity assignment
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQXftB7pSBetnK4NoZD2gaR)_

Part of #25653

Clause-②: no (narrowing: an app-authored hook's inherited or sudo() elevation, and an action reached through ObjectRepository.execute(), are refused the four identity objects at run time, as a runAs: 'system' hook already is)
Metadata-protocol: none

Slice 2 of the card's run-time half. It closes the inherited-context path that slice 1's report (#25954) names among its findings: an app-authored hook that declares no `runAs` and runs under a system context it inherits. It also closes the two neighbouring elevations the order asked to be measured, the in-process `ctx.api.sudo()` and `ObjectRepository.execute()`.

## What changed

Slice 1 refuses writes to the four identity objects from a context with `isSystem` and either a `flowRunId` or the app-automation mark. The mark was set only on a hook's `runAs: 'system'` api and on an action body's context. Three other app-authored elevations carried `isSystem` with neither, so the refusal did not see them.

| Context | Governed write to `sys_user_position`, `sys_user_permission_set`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_member` | Writes to other objects |
|---|---|---|
| app-authored hook, no `runAs`, system context inherited (body or handler) | **refused, PERMISSION_DENIED** (was: admitted) | admitted |
| app-authored hook's in-process `ctx.api.sudo()`, under any `runAs`, also inside `ctx.api.transaction` | **refused** (was: admitted) | admitted |
| action reached through `ctx.api.object(x).execute(y)` | **refused** (was: admitted) | admitted |
| app-authored hook, no `runAs`, user's context inherited | not judged here; the ordinary gates judge the user | per the user |
| hook registered in code (`engine.registerHook`, no metadata binding), its api and its `sudo()` | admitted, unchanged | admitted |
| platform `sudo()`, bare `{ isSystem: true }` writers | admitted, unchanged | admitted |

**The predicate that tells app-authored hooks from platform hooks is the hook binder.** A hook is app-authored when it is bound through `bindHooksToEngine`. That is the one door metadata hooks come through: stack and package `hooks:`, runtime-authored hooks, and app artifacts. It is also the set the engine already treats as automations: the binder registers each hook with `meta`, and `skipAutomations` skips exactly those. A platform hook is registered in code with `engine.registerHook` and no `meta`. The audit builtins, security, and every plugin's own hooks are registered this way, and their path does not change.

- `objectql` `hook-binder.ts`: the binder passes `appAuthored: true` to `wrapDeclarativeHook`.
- `objectql` `hook-wrappers.ts`: when `appAuthored` is set, the wrapper derives the hook's `ctx.api` through a new key before it applies `runAs`, so every `runAs` keeps the provenance. The step is synchronous, so an `'inherit'` hook gains no extra `await`. An async (fire-and-forget) hook runs on the detached copy whenever an api was installed. A platform wrap (no flag) still hands the api through by reference.
- `objectql` `hook-run-as.ts`: `APP_AUTHORED_HOOK_API` and `deriveAppAuthoredHookApi`. The key is a symbol and is not exported from the package entry, the same posture as `SEED_USER_GRANTS`.
- `objectql` `ScopedContext`:
  - `[APP_AUTHORED_HOOK_API]()` marks an inherited `isSystem` context `'hook'` when it has no `flowRunId` and no mark.
  - A private `appAuthored` flag rides every derived child (`transaction`, `beginTransaction`, `withRunAs`, the grant seeding) through one `derive()` helper.
  - `sudo()` marks `'hook'` only on an app-authored api. Platform `sudo()` is byte-identical.
- `objectql` `ObjectRepository.execute()` marks its elevation `'action'`, as `buildActionExecutionContext` already does for the REST and MCP action doors. The census found no caller of `execute()` in objectstack, `examples/`, `apps/` or HotCRM.
- `plugin-security`: no predicate change. The hook's subject and prescription now name the three ways a hook is elevated, and the module doc covers them.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 1b names the new producers and anchors the new `isSystem` read (`engine.ts#inheritsElevation`); `check-system-context-census` exits 0.
- Changeset: `objectql` and `plugin-security` `patch`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Measured before any code (the order's question)

On `main` `59d9181e`, with a real `ObjectQL`, the SQL driver, `SecurityPlugin` and QuickJS:

- **Does app-authored code reach `ctx.api.sudo()`?** Yes, from an in-process handler. Its writes carried `isSystem` and no mark. A sandboxed body does not reach it, because the sandbox api exposes neither `sudo` nor `execute`.
- **Does it reach `ObjectRepository.execute()`?** Yes, from an in-process handler, through `ctx.api.object(x).execute(y)`. The action it reached ran with an elevated, unmarked `api`.
- An action host handler's own `sudo()` was already refused, because the action context's mark rides the spread.

Both reaches were measured as reachable, so both are fixed here.

Census: no hook, action body or host handler in objectstack (`packages/`, `examples/`, `apps/`) or HotCRM writes the four objects, calls `sudo()` from app code, or calls `execute()`. Nothing shipped starts being refused.

## Tests

- `runtime/src/app-automation-identity-write-refusal.integration.test.ts`: 50 new cases beside slice 1's 50. They use the same real stack and read the store back past the middleware.
  - A hook with no `runAs` (body and handler) under a platform system write, × four objects × insert/update/delete, is refused with code, status, subject and prescription. The store does not move and the triggering write aborts. 24 cases.
  - A hook's in-process `sudo()` under a user's write, × four × three verbs, is refused. One more case covers it inside `ctx.api.transaction` and under `runAs: 'user'`. 13 cases.
  - An action reached through `execute()` is refused on each of the four objects. 4 cases.
  - Controls, 9 cases:
    - the inheriting hook still writes another object;
    - under a user's write, the ordinary gates refuse the plain member, and this refusal does not;
    - a hook registered in code, its `sudo()`, and the declarative wrapper with no binding all write each of the four objects.
  - **Red first** (commit `cb6bb395`, before the fix): 41 refusal cases failed and 59 passed (slice 1's 50 plus the 9 controls).
- `objectql/src/hook-run-as.test.ts`: 4 new cases.
  - An inherited system context is marked, but a run's context and a user's are not.
  - `sudo()` is marked under every `runAs`.
  - A platform wrap keeps the api by reference and marks nothing.
  - The binder binds hooks as app-authored.
  - The published-face pin now counts two unexported symbol-keyed members.
- `plugin-security` refusal test: the hook row's message pin follows the new wording.

Pins describe behaviour only.

## Verification

Head `d0489d5e`. Its tree is identical to `7d29c9ab`, where every reading below was taken: the commit messages were reworded before the first push and the files did not change. All readings ran under the verify lock.

- `pnpm test`, each with VERDICT `command-exit 0`:
  - objectql: 469 files, 8734 passed;
  - plugin-security: 223 files, 4683 passed, 45 skipped;
  - runtime: 447 files, 7232 passed, 19 skipped;
  - core: 119 files, 2763 passed.
  - Runtime and core ran at the fix commit `4a7683e2`. Only objectql and plugin-security test files, the docs page and the changeset changed after it. Runtime reads both of those packages from `dist/`, and `dist/` was built from the fix commit.
- `pnpm typecheck` in objectql, plugin-security and runtime exits 0 each, including `check:test-typecheck`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 8 changed TypeScript files exits 0.
- `check-system-context-census` exits 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands` on the real diff, 106 families): all 106 exit 0 on the first pass. Reconciled with `--ran`: 106 derived, 106 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): one behaviour per run, each marker proven in objectql `dist/` by `ablation-dist-preflight` before the readings.
  - **A, the discriminator** (the binder's `appAuthored: true` forced to `false`). Runtime pin: 37 failed, 63 passed. The 37 are exactly the inherited-context and `sudo()` cases; the `execute()` cases, slice 1's cases and every control stay green. objectql pin: 1 failed (the binder case), 28 passed.
  - **B, `execute()`'s mark** (`'action'` forced to none). Runtime pin: 4 failed, 96 passed. The 4 are exactly the `execute()` cases. objectql pin: 29 passed.
  - Restore: blob equals HEAD for both files, `git diff HEAD` is empty and `git status --porcelain` is clean. After the rebuild, both markers are absent from `dist/` (preflight `--absent` exits 0) and the runtime pin is 100/100 again.
- Full dogfood battery (owed for the `(narrowing)` arm): it was running at this tree when this PR was opened. Its counts go in the `os-dev-report` on #25653.

## Acceptance notes

- Claimed surface: the hook wrapper, binder and `ScopedContext` in objectql, plus `ObjectRepository.execute()` as the order's measurement asked. The refusal module changed its wording only. No `packages/spec/**`, no new error code, and the predicate is unchanged.
- The mark is the slice 1 symbol. A `flowRunId` context is still answered as the flow's, and a context that already carries a mark keeps it.
- Branch is the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-hg746g`; the claim comment is the identity record.
